reasons: Cited § 22.1–22.3 satisfies every preferred element: once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems/data.
No walk-away trigger (no unlimited/unannounced audits, no remote system access), and § 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections, so no redline or comment is appropriate.

Redline is unchanged from the original text and no comment is attached, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; deterministic check on audit frequency passes and rationale accurately reflects the clause.
